Returns a default AsyncLoggerConfig with info level, JSON format, and stdout output.Forward declaration of the no-field log overload.Forward declaration of the field-carrying log overload.Enqueues msg at level into the AsyncLogger ring buffer.Enqueues msg with key-value fields at level into the ring buffer.Logs msg at trace level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg at debug level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg at info level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg at warn level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg at error level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg at fatal level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg with key-value fields at trace level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg with key-value fields at debug level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg with key-value fields at info level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg with key-value fields at warn level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg with key-value fields at error level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg with key-value fields at fatal level through the AsyncLogger.Logs msg at level and appends the JSON form of obj as raw fields.Logs msg at trace level with the JSON form of obj appended.Logs msg at debug level with the JSON form of obj appended.Logs msg at info level with the JSON form of obj appended.Logs msg at warn level with the JSON form of obj appended.Logs msg at error level with the JSON form of obj appended.Logs msg at fatal level with the JSON form of obj appended.Creates an AsyncLogger from config and starts its flush thread when threads are enabled.Stops the logger and waits for the flush thread to finish. File/stdout/stderr writes use blocking POSIX write semantics; if the target fd is a blocked FIFO/pipe/device, close can remain blocked until the fd accepts data or fails.Closes logger and deallocates its storage, then sets the handle to nil.Alias of destroy for idiomatic disposal of the AsyncLogger handle.Waits until all enqueued entries have been written to the output.Returns how many entries were dropped because the ring buffer was full.Returns how many times a write to the output fd failed.Changes the minimum LogLevel that logger will emit.Installs a new default AsyncLogger built from config, destroying the previous one.Closes and destroys the current default AsyncLogger.Return the current default logger as a borrowed pointer. Prefer logDefault/flushDefaultLogger for concurrent code because they hold the publication lock across the operation.Returns true when a default AsyncLogger is installed.Logs message at level through the current default AsyncLogger.Flushes the current default AsyncLogger if one is installed.

Types

AsyncLogger = ptr AsyncLoggerObj
AsyncLoggerConfig = object
  level*: LogLevel
  format*: LogFormat
  output*: LogOutput
  filePath*: string
  bufferSize*: int
  maxEntryBytes*: int
  flushIntervalMs*: int
  dropOnFull*: bool
  includeSource*: bool
  colorize*: bool
LogFormat = enum
  lfJson, lfText, lfCompact
LogLevel = enum
  llTrace, llDebug, llInfo, llWarn, llError, llFatal
LogOutput = enum
  loStdout, loStderr, loFile
